notes.incidents_declare: In the demo nothing is declared: in a Lemma this makes INC-15, opens #inc-15-…, invites the people, pins a header the Lemma keeps current, tells #incidents and asks for a likely cause.
notes.incidents_investigate: In the demo the Lemma isn't asked again: in a Lemma the investigator reads the timeline, the changes before it and the connected sources, and names every source it couldn't check.
notes.incidents_draft_update: In the demo no new update is drafted: in a Lemma it is drafted from the timeline, and nothing is sent until the lead says so.
notes.incidents_setup_save: In the demo the set-up isn't saved.
notes.incidents_sample_data: In the demo the sample stays.
